Important communique

Dear Valued Customer,
We would like to inform you of the following planned intervention on our IT Infrastructure, during which cbris online systems and services,
will not be accessible:

i) From Saturday 6th September, 23:00 to Sunday 7th September, 05:00
ii) From Saturday 13th September, 23:00 to Sunday 14th September, 05:00

We apologise for any inconvenience these downtimes may cause.
